svg.text: A244 -- 12-STUCK: every one of the twelve border cells met by two squares

Cells: corner boxes c00 (amber), wall slots c01 up the wall (blue) and c10 along the floor (green), in each corner frame. Orange = a square meeting at least one cell, blue = free. Under each cell: its meeters.
(A) WHAT IT IS: the least-side CERTIFIED 12-stuck packing of 11 unit squares, at side 4.000009801 (= the raw optimum 4.000009801 inflated by lam = 1.0 so that every
wall and pair gap is >= 0 in 40-digit interval arithmetic). Crowd margin delta = 1e-05; run a217:crowd_10_0380|crowd0.02|twelve|d1e-05.
GEOMETRY CHECK (this panel, as drawn): contained and pairwise interior-disjoint = True, min wall gap 9.67e-10, min pair gap 5.34e-11; 12 of 12 cells doubly met,
worst second depth 1.005e-05. Fritz-John on the FREE rows (no crowd rows): residual 0.2745154222227807; every meeter loaded: False; LOCKED: False.
The side is ABOVE 4 and therefore above s-hat = 3.877084 by 0.122926.
(B) the BL corner magnified (BL00, BL01, BL10)
cells doubly met; the 0 cells in RED
are singly met. Check True, gaps 1.4e-10 / 1.2e-09.
(D) the best the probe reached at side 3.998000
(D) WHAT IT IS: the least-residual configuration the fixed-side probe reached BELOW 4 (side 3.998000). It is NOT a packing: residual 3.451e-06
(min wall gap -3.35e-06, min pair gap -3.45e-06, worst second depth 6.55e-06). 12 of 12 cells doubly met.
